end.summary:
Practised identifying standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines.
Om identified a standing line using cricket stumps as an example.
Om recognised that slanting lines are straight but tilted.
Om called V-shaped lines curved because of the corner; this was not corrected by the end.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Om practised sorting standing, sleeping and slanting lines by their direction. They used the cricket-stumps example and later stated that a slanting line is straight but tilted. There was a mix-up between a smooth curved line and a V-shaped line with a corner, and it was not corrected by the end. At home, show a few examples of U, V, and zigzag shapes and ask Om to point out which have smooth curves and which are made of straight lines.
